title: Uka Pacientejj
intro: Nayrajja, jaqenakan nayrïr urunakapanjja, pä almanakaw Luriripan nayraqatapan ofrendanakampi saytʼasipjjäna. Maynix katuqatäxänwa, maynix janiw katuqatäkänti. Kunatix qhipat utjkän ukax nayrïr jach’a jan walt’äwiruw jila kullakanak taypin tukuñapäna - mä pacienciampi jark’aqasiñampi ukat mä q’añu venganzampi. ¿Khitïtsa uk qhanañchtʼasmati?
clues: Jaqenakajj aka Oraqen jakapkäna uka nayrïr urunakanwa nasta
Nayax nayrïr panin jaqinakan wawapätwa, jupanakax aka uraqin sarnaqapxirïtwa
Mä kutejja, Luririjar kusisiyañatakejj ovejanakajat wali suma sacrificio loqtjjayäta
Nayan ofrendajajj alajjpachat katoqatäjjänwa, jilajan ofrendapasti janiw katoqatäkänti
Jiwayañ ajjsarayapjjetäna ukhajja, jilajar jan amparaj luqtañwa amtayäta
Jaqinakan sarnaqäwipanx nayrïr jaqiruw tukuwayta, yaqha jaqimp jan wali jiwayata

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Ismail jupan sacrificiopax Ibrahim jupan luratawa

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Mä thujru, ukax mä katariruw tukuwayi
Mä hoopoe jamach’ix reyin yatiyawip apt’atawa

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Jaqinakan sarnaqäwipanx nayrïr jiwayat jaqiruw tukuwayi
Mä lawat lurat barco manqhan mä jach’a uma jalsut qhispiwayi
Mä jach’a challwa puraka manqhan jakasïna
Pusi tunka maraw mä jach’a wasaran sarnaqäna
outcome.answer: Jaqinakan sarnaqäwipanx nayrïr jiwayat jaqiruw tukuwayi

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
